title.narrative: Turkmenistan: Enhancing trade resilience and integration

description.narrative: The project, funded by the European Union, aims to promote economic development and decent work in Turkmenistan by improving the business climate and enhancing the competitiveness of SMEs. This initiative will support Turkmenistan's engagement in regional and global trade, including with the European Union. The project is part of the Turkmenistan Cooperation Facility of the European Union. Project objectives: Strengthened capacities of policymakers for participation in the WTO accession process; Enhanced SME integration in sustainable value chains; Strengthened capacity of institutions to implement trade facilitation reforms; Improved gender-responsive trade facilitation practices: Improved ecosystem for investment facilitation and e-commerce.
